{{Quote|Welcome to Blue Sector&mdash;gangland central. For the thugs around here war's good for business, and I've got terrified citizens to prove it.|Danod|<ref name="Local Trouble" />}}
'''Danod''' was a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] in the [[Corellian Security Force]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]], Danod tried to protect civilians in the [[Blue Sector/Legends|Blue Sector]] from the vicious [[Coronas]] gang, but was forced to seek help from Republic forces after the gang murdered [[Ben Kahob]] for stockpiling medkits for the resistance.<ref name="Local Trouble" />
